6. Infectious Diseases

6.1 Bacterial Infections

Examples: - Tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) - Streptococcal
pharyngitis - Sepsis

Antibiotic resistance is a major global concern.

6.2 Viral Infections

Examples: - Influenza - HIV - COVID-19

Vaccination remains the most effective preventive strategy.

metadata.document_summary: This research article explores the mechanisms and epidemiology of infectious diseases, focusing on bacterial and viral infections. It aims to provide insights into disease prevention strategies for healthcare professionals and public health officials.
